### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Vectorized, mathematically sound implementation.

### ⚡ Implementation
```python
def solve(s):
    def pal(i,j):
      while i<j:
       if s[i]!=s[j]: return False
       i+=1; j-=1
      return True
    i,j=0,len(s)-1
    while i<j:
      if s[i]!=s[j]: return pal(i+1,j) or pal(i,j-1)
      i+=1; j-=1
    return True
```

- **Space Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(N)$
